config.purpose: freeze the learned block offset choices after epoch50; continue weights51-55; historical dynamic control
config.weight_preprocess: original W32 G(W); detached mean(abs(W)), tanh/max normalization
config.activation_policy: original A32/ReLU in ALL THREE modes
config.mx_group_axis: flatten Cin*Kh*Kw within each Cout, zero-pad tail
config.mx_scale_policy: unchanged E4M3 source scale floor(log2(amax))-8; both lower codes equal source E8M0 code plus per-block hard offset5/6; promoted integer addition; overflow rejected without clipping/wrap, including zero blocks
config.mx_rounding: E4M3 source nearest ties-to-even; finite FP32 source, scalar subnormal flush; lower modes exact bit mappings without additional rounding
config.ste_policy: identity wrt G(W) all three modes; theta gradient ln(2)*sum_real_block(grad_q*q) from E2M3/E2M1; no normalization; no direct E4 theta gradient; source codes/scales detached; retain G(W) derivatives
config.numeric_kernel: FP32 F.conv2d; codec FP64 intermediates; not native low-bit kernels
config.scale_gradient: ln(2)*sum_real_block(grad_q*q); accumulate E2M3 and E2M1 only
config.quantization_source: one current E4M3 encoding per MX layer and minibatch, shared across all three modes
config.exponent_mapping: s e3 e2 e1 e0 m2 m1 m0 -> s e3 e2 m2 m1 m0; target bias1; no bias compensation
config.mantissa_mapping: derived E2M3 uint8 codes >> 2; exact same per-block learned scale as E2M3
config.source_cache_policy: detached integer source, hard choices and derived codes; theta version fixed within triplet; cached q saved for backward; cleared before Adam
config.loss: E4M3 hard CE + E2M3 soft CE from detached E4M3 + E2M1 soft CE from detached E2M3; T=1; gradients summed, no division by 3
config.batchnorm_policy: normal training updates of three mode banks E4M3=8,E2M3=32,E2M1=4; parameters and running stats learn per mode; eval frozen; keys are storage IDs, all A32; banks1/2 unused
config.initialization_policy: strict restore of the verified learned-scale reference checkpoint after epoch50
config.evaluation_policy: all three modes on complete official test after every epoch; hard CE for each
config.selection_policy: first strict maximum of E4M3 official-test top1 within new epochs51-55 only
config.reporting_policy: primary endpoint55; secondary shared E4M3-best within51-55; all modes at that same epoch
config.rng_policy: global streams as upstream; sequential dropout draws per mode; saved at epoch boundaries
config.checkpoint_policy: immutable FP32 training state per epoch and selected best/last copies
config.export_policy: one E4M3 source plus packed one-bit block choices and BN auxiliary state; derive lower exports only from saved source codes/scales/choices; no MX masters or FP32 theta in compact exports; resume retains theta and Adam
config.freeze_method: theta Adam-group lr=0; requires_grad remains true; scheduler scale group lr/base_lrs/last_lr zero
config.scale_choices_provenance: learned in parent epochs1-50, frozen throughout continuation
config.historical_control: original learned-scale reference100, observed epochs51-55; no control retraining
config.completion_policy: five new epochs51-55; no restart of the 100-epoch schedule

limitations: Historical dynamic control; no additional control training.
CUDA repeat/resume is not bitexact; a small difference is not proof of superiority.
Official test used for E4 checkpoint selection; no independent validation estimate.
Theta LR is zero; gradients and Adam moments still computed. No optimized runtime/energy claim.
Only new epochs51-55; this does not establish an optimal freeze epoch.
A32 activations and FP32 masters; numerical MX emulation.
